entry_points.text: Share, relax and mark-young act on current non-protected vCPU with table refill before sharing; unshare, write-protect and age-test resolve VM by handle then release and report status.
TLB shims translate MMU pointer and invoke matching flush; protected flush ignores unknown handles; timer installs counter offset; SSBS forces safe speculation; plus PC adjust and VM flush.

Hypercalls unpack host registers, translate addresses and return status; init forwards donation, requires page alignment and never returns on success; private-mapping failures encode as pointer errors.

exports.text: Host-guest sharing offers share, unshare, relax, write-protect, age-test and mark-young by frame and count; VM handles resolve with refcount and a non-protected variant.

Stage2 tables map, unmap, look up leaves, decode protections, relax via masks with flush, write-protect, age and range-flush; map rejects identity mismatch and carries backing, MMU, cache and force flag; roots sized from caller memory, torn down fully.
TLB service invalidates per-IPA, non-shareable IPA, range, whole VMID and local CPU plus instruction cache, bracketing with VMID context entry and ordered barriers.

Private VA reserves forward-only ranges with rounding and limit, preserving offset; installs vectors by slot, identity with I/O and vmemmap split, and double stacks mapping upper half; hyp maps under lock and backs vmemmap without overlap.

Protected VMs reserve, release, init, prepare and teardown stage2 plus one-shot protection; reserve yields handles, init pins and maps donations then publishes with sized descriptor; stage2 runs under per-VM guard.

GIC probe detects MMIO via save, disable, read-back and restore under IRQ mask and clears list registers; SVE maps per-CPU when present, boot writes root with clean, sysreg validated increasing, pools init with guards.

hazards.text: Erratum path disables refills via exclusion bits and restores only if changed; GIC probe masks IRQs; init requires page alignment; missing tables, bad handles and overflows fail with unwind.

invariants.text: Donation rejects host owner, requires memory range with start and end in same block, checks field fits, syncs conditionally then marks ownerless; guest metadata packs handle and frame.

Share validates range, size and memory, requires unmapped dest then maps borrowed with counts, failing busy at max and on multi-share except host case; unshare verifies, unmaps and restores sole owner at zero with distinct errors.
Guest state reports poison for invalid poisoned entries, absent for other invalid, else decoded protections; range checks walk leaf-only with desired state and decoder.

Prot conversion forbids device combos, encodes exec, read, write, shareability defaulting inner and software; XN maps four combos via capability; unmap uses leaf coverage with range flush when supported.
Relax and age ops validate size, assert shared state in debug, update leaves under guest lock; relax refuses soft bits and flushes; write-protect clears write, youth sets access flag.

Early allocator carves self-test, vmemmap, VM table, hyp and host tables and proxy in order; rebuild installs identity, vectors, sections, pool and per-CPU; finalize snapshots, enables, flushes, reloads and invalidates once.
Handles add offset; init sizes descriptor, maps donations, inits stage2 then publishes; descriptors link host and arch, inherit counter and controls with filtered flags for protected guests.

Pool bounds max order by size and limit with per-order lists, marks pages refcounted order zero and returns beyond prefix; release needs zero refs; buddy flips bit, rejects out-of-range, merges same-order keeping lower head and queues.

locks.text: Per-VM spin lock records current VM; share and unshare hold host then guest and release reverse; page-state checks require lock held.
VM table guard serializes reserve, install and clear; slots go empty to reserved to installed to empty, install needs reserved and release only reserved; helpers require guard held.
Private reservation requires guard held, public wrapper acquires it, stack holds it across reserve and install with cursor rollback on failure.
Vector install selects base by hardening slot with per-CPU storage; vector and boot updates rely on per-CPU isolation.

state_machines.text: nVHE fast-paths current ctx else parks controls, loads target and barriers; VHE saves IRQs and clears TGE; exit restores MMU and controls; record holds saved MMU, regs and flags.
APRS shims resolve host and protected vCPUs, no-op when host missing; direct path uses host only, protected path copies control and groups with fixed enable on restore.

structs.text: Free lists reuse freed page memory as list node via page-to-address conversion; removal unlinks and clears node, insertion appends to order list.
